title: About time? The role of time perspective in the priority for positive over negative emotion in attention.
summary: Compared to younger adults, older adults often prioritise processing positive information and deprioritize processing negative information. Known as the positivity effect, its mechanisms remain debated. One explanation of the positivity effect is that older adults are influenced by a sense of limited time left in life to focus more on emotional well-being compared with younger adults. Previous research shows that experimentally manipulating time perspective can mimic the positivity effect in younger adults, however, such findings have relied on designs where participants can reflect on emotional images they are viewing. In the current study, we examined if time perspective manipulations would similarly elicit positivity effect patterns in younger adults using an emotion-attention task with a rapid stimuli display. Across three experiments (N = 236, N = 431, and N = 259), we found that time perspective had little influence on attentional biases toward positive over negative emotional stimuli in younger adults. Additionally, when we incorporated a memory task into the design, effects of time perspective were not consistent with previous findings - in fact, patterns were in the opposite direction. We discuss these results as they relate to theories and the advantages and disadvantages of tasks used to examine the positivity effect.

标题：关于时间？时间视角在注意力中对正性情绪优先于负性情绪的作用
摘要：与年轻人相比，老年人往往优先处理正性信息，而降低对负性信息的处理优先级。这种现象被称为“正性效应”，但其机制仍存在争议。正性效应的一种解释是，老年人受到生命中剩余时间有限的感觉影响，从而比年轻人更关注情绪健康。先前的研究表明，通过实验操纵时间视角可以在年轻人中模拟正性效应，然而这些发现依赖于参与者能够反思他们所观看的情绪性图像的研究设计。在当前研究中，我们通过一项使用快速刺激呈现的情绪-注意力任务，考察了时间视角操纵是否同样能在年轻人中诱发正性效应模式。通过三项实验（N=236、N=431和N=259），我们发现时间视角对年轻人注意偏向正性情绪刺激（相对于负性情绪刺激）的影响很小。此外，当我们在设计中加入记忆任务时，时间视角的效果与先前研究结果不一致——事实上，模式呈现出相反方向。我们讨论了这些结果与理论的关系，以及用于考察正性效应的任务的优缺点。
关键词：正性效应；时间视角；注意力；情绪；年龄差异

title: Neural representations of popularity and leadership status relate to conformity in daily life.
summary: Individuals are motivated to increase their social status. To succeed in this pursuit, people must track information about others in their social sphere, monitor group norms, and adjust their behavior strategically. This study employed functional MRI and ecological momentary assessment methods in a sample of 92 college students belonging to 9 social groups to elucidate the neural mechanisms underlying these processes and their relationship to conformity in the context of alcohol use. When young adults passively looked at faces of their real-life social group peers, brain systems implicated in valuation and social cognition spontaneously tracked information about the popularity and leadership status of the social targets in an interdependent manner. Individual differences in these neural valuations were systematically associated with varying levels of conformity. Students who had stronger responses to faces of peers with relatively higher popularity and leadership status than themselves in one key valuation brain region, the ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC), were more likely to align their drinking behavior with their groups' norms in everyday life. These results provide evidence for how brain systems involved in valuation and social cognition flexibly track information about peers' popularity and leadership status in real-life social groups and contribute to a growing literature on the neural mechanisms through which social comparison processes shape conformity. Our study highlights the vmPFC as a central hub that spontaneously tracks status differences between the self and peers and uses this information to guide behavior to match group norms.

标题：人气与领导地位的神经表征与日常生活中的从众行为相关
摘要：个体有动机提升自身社会地位。为实现这一目标，人们必须追踪社交圈中他人的信息、监测群体规范，并策略性地调整自身行为。本研究采用功能磁共振成像和生态瞬时评估方法，对92名来自9个社会群体的大学生样本进行调查，以阐明这些过程的神经机制及其在饮酒情境下与从众行为的关系。当年轻人被动观看真实社交群体同伴的面孔时，涉及价值评估和社会认知的大脑系统会以相互依赖的方式自发追踪社交目标的人气和领导地位信息。这些神经评估的个体差异与不同程度的从众行为系统性相关。在一个关键的价值评估脑区——腹内侧前额叶皮层中，对人气和领导地位相对高于自身的同伴面孔反应更强的学生，更倾向于在日常生活中将其饮酒行为与群体规范保持一致。这些结果揭示了大脑中参与价值评估和社会认知的系统如何灵活追踪真实社交群体中同伴人气和领导地位的信息，并为社会比较过程塑造从众行为的神经机制研究增添了新的证据。本研究强调腹内侧前额叶皮层是一个核心枢纽，能够自发追踪自我与他人之间的地位差异，并利用这些信息指导行为以符合群体规范。
关键词：人气；领导地位；腹内侧前额叶皮层；从众行为；社会认知

title: Reading ability in both deaf and hearing adults is linked to neural representations of abstract phonology derived from visual speech.
summary: Reading is central to academic and vocational success. Some deaf children face reading challenges due to limited access to spoken or signed language. Robust phonological representations are key to reading development in hearing children. Spoken language phonology may be one of many contributors to reading development in deaf children. Indeed, speechreading ability correlates with reading skill in both deaf and hearing individuals, suggesting it is linked to reading development regardless of hearing status. Further support for this hypothesis would be provided by evidence that similar neural representations of speech phonology are evoked by visual speech and other language forms (auditory speech and text) and that these neural representations are related to reading proficiency. We used fMRI and representational similarity analysis (RSA) to identify shared neural representations of spoken language phonological structure. A group of deaf adult participants (N = 22), with a mixture of sign language and spoken language backgrounds and reading abilities, were presented with single lexical items as visual speech and dynamic text (cursive text, revealed letter-by-letter to promote a phonological reading strategy). Adult hearing participants (N = 25) were presented with the same words, but as visual speech and auditory speech. Shared neural representations of phonological structure of English words were found in each group in the superior and middle temporal cortex (STC/MTC) and these abstract representations were more similar across different language forms in better readers. Our data provide neurobiological evidence of the contribution of visual speech to abstract phonological representations of spoken language, that relate to reading proficiency, in both deaf and hearing adults.

标题：聋人和听力正常成年人的阅读能力与源自视觉语音的抽象音韵神经表征相关  
摘要：阅读是学业和职业成功的关键。部分聋儿因缺乏对口语或手语的充分接触而面临阅读挑战。稳健的音韵表征是听力正常儿童阅读发展的关键。口语语音可能是聋儿阅读发展的众多影响因素之一。事实上，无论听力状况如何，聋人和听力正常个体的读唇能力均与阅读技能相关，这表明读唇能力与阅读发展存在关联。支持这一假说的进一步证据需要证明：视觉语音与其他语言形式（听觉语音和文本）能诱发相似的语音音韵神经表征，且这些神经表征与阅读能力相关。我们使用功能磁共振成像（fMRI）和表征相似性分析（RSA）来识别口语语音结构的共享神经表征。一组聋人成年参与者（N=22），具有不同的手语和口语背景及阅读能力，被呈现以单个词汇项目作为视觉语音和动态文本（逐字母揭示的草书文本，以促进音韵阅读策略）。听力正常成年参与者（N=25）被呈现相同词汇，但作为视觉语音和听觉语音。两组参与者在颞上回和颞中回（STC/MTC）中均发现了英语单词音韵结构的共享神经表征，且这些抽象表征在阅读能力更好的个体中跨不同语言形式更为相似。我们的数据提供了神经生物学证据，表明在聋人和听力正常成年人中，视觉语音对与阅读能力相关的口语抽象音韵表征有贡献。  
关键词：视觉语音；音韵表征；阅读能力；聋人；功能磁共振成像

title: Impact of sex chromosomes and gonad type in stress susceptibility in corticostriatal brain regions.
summary: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is characterized by symptom heterogeneity and sex differences in prevalence. To gain insight into these sex differences, we utilized the subchronic variable stress paradigm (SCVS) in which female mice are susceptible, while males are behaviorally resilient. We used the Four Core Genotypes mice to differentiate between sex chromosome complement (XX vs. XY) and gonad type (ovaries vs. testes) in stress susceptibility, uncoupling these factors by removing the testes-determining SRY gene from the Y chromosome. Mice were subjected to SCVS followed by assays to assess anxiety-/depressive-like behaviors. Regardless of gonads, XX mice were stress susceptible, while XY mice were stress resilient, underscoring the importance of sex chromosome effects to sex differences in susceptibility to SCVS, independent of gonad type. We then performed RNA-sequencing of the prefrontal cortex (PFC) and nucleus accumbens (NAc). Consistent with human MDD and previous rodent SCVS findings, there was little overlap in genes altered by SCVS across sex. In stress susceptible XX mice, stress exposure altered pathways related to immune function, while in resilient XY mice, stress exposure altered pathways involved in neuronal function. There was brain region specificity to how sex chromosome complement and gonad type contributed to sex-specific stress effects. In the NAc, sex chromosome complement was the primary contributor to stress-induced gene expression, while in the PFC, both sex chromosome complement and gonad type contributed. These findings underscore a complex relationship between sex chromosome complement and gonadal factors in shaping stress vulnerability, partly through immune-related pathways.

标题：性染色体与性腺类型在皮质-纹状体脑区应激易感性中的影响
摘要：重度抑郁障碍（MDD）表现为症状异质性和患病率的性别差异。为了深入探究这些性别差异，我们采用了亚慢性可变应激范式（SCVS），其中雌性小鼠表现出易感性，而雄性小鼠在行为上具有韧性。我们利用四核心基因型小鼠模型，区分性染色体组成（XX vs. XY）和性腺类型（卵巢 vs. 睾丸）对应激易感性的影响，并通过从Y染色体上移除睾丸决定基因SRY来解耦这些因素。小鼠接受SCVS处理后，通过实验评估焦虑/抑郁样行为。无论性腺类型如何，XX小鼠均表现出应激易感性，而XY小鼠则表现出应激韧性，这强调了性染色体效应在SCVS易感性性别差异中的重要性，且独立于性腺类型。随后，我们对前额叶皮层（PFC）和伏隔核（NAc）进行了RNA测序。与人类MDD及先前啮齿类动物SCVS研究结果一致，不同性别间由SCVS改变的基因重叠很少。在应激易感性的XX小鼠中，应激暴露改变了与免疫功能相关的通路；而在应激韧性的XY小鼠中，应激暴露改变了涉及神经元功能的通路。性染色体组成和性腺类型对性别特异性应激效应的贡献具有脑区特异性。在NAc中，性染色体组成是应激诱导基因表达的主要贡献因素；而在PFC中，性染色体组成和性腺类型均有贡献。这些发现强调了性染色体组成与性腺因素在塑造应激易感性中的复杂关系，部分通过免疫相关通路实现。
关键词：性别差异；应激易感性；性染色体；性腺；免疫通路

title: Just Like My CEO: When Perceived Similarity Makes Pay Inequality Acceptable.
summary: Large CEO-employee pay gaps often elicit negative reactions, yet they have reached historic highs with limited resistance. How can this be explained? Developing a novel social comparison perspective, we propose that under specific circumstances pay inequality may yield positive reactions. We argue that perceived similarity with a CEO enhances acceptance of CEO pay, a process driven by elevated inspiration. We tested this prediction in four studies: a large international archival survey, a pre-registered survey of U.S. employees, and two pre-registered experiments. In the archival survey, we demonstrate that perceived similarity to CEOs, when measured indirectly, reduced support for income-inequality-reduction policies, and this effect appears-to-emerge across cultures. Converging experimental evidence reveals that employees who perceived greater similarity to their CEOs are more accepting of high CEO pay, due to feeling more inspired. These findings help elucidate why extreme pay disparities are often accepted, even though they may reinforce broader societal inequality.
translation:
相关性：是  
标题：如同我的CEO：当感知相似性使得薪酬不平等变得可接受  
摘要：CEO与员工之间巨大的薪酬差距常引发负面反应，然而这种差距却达到了历史最高水平且鲜有抵制。如何解释这一现象？通过提出一种新颖的社会比较视角，我们主张在特定情况下，薪酬不平等可能产生积极反应。我们认为，与CEO的感知相似性会增强对CEO薪酬的接受度，这一过程由提升的灵感驱动。我们在四项研究中验证了这一预测：一项大规模国际档案调查、一项针对美国员工的预注册调查，以及两项预注册实验。在档案调查中，我们证明，当间接测量时，与CEO的感知相似性降低了对减少收入不平等政策的支持，且这种效应似乎跨文化存在。一致的实验证据表明，感知与CEO更为相似的员工更接受高额CEO薪酬，原因是他们感到更受启发。这些发现有助于阐明为何极端薪酬差异常被接受，尽管它们可能加剧更广泛的社会不平等。  
关键词：感知相似性；薪酬不平等；社会比较；灵感；情绪/情感

title: Differential Responses to Group and Individual Emotional Voices: A Behavioral and ERP Study.
summary: Human beings live in social groups, and processing group emotions is crucial for interacting with and understanding others' behaviors and feelings. The present study investigated the cognitive and neural mechanisms of processing group versus individual emotional voices within the auditory modality. We examined ERP responses of 34 participants to group and individual voices across three emotional valences (negative, neutral, positive). Behavioral results revealed a significant interaction: group voices yielded shorter reaction times for neutral and positive emotions but longer for negative ones, alongside more positive overall emotional reactions. Electrophysiologically, group voices elicited more positive N1 and larger P2 amplitudes, with shorter latencies. More specifically, for negative and positive voices, group voices elicited larger P2 amplitudes than individual voices, while no significant difference between group and individual voices emerged for neutral voices. Furthermore, P2 amplitudes elicited by group voices were negatively correlated with participants' trait cognitive empathy. These results suggest that group voices elicit stronger early neural responses driven by an interplay of acoustic and social salience. Importantly, rather than demonstrating a direct empathy-specific neural mechanism, the observed negative correlation suggests that trait empathy may play a role in modulating the early sensory detection and attentional processing of complex, collective emotional signals.

标题：群体与个体情绪声音的差异化反应：一项行为与ERP研究
摘要：人类生活在社会群体中，处理群体情绪对于与他人互动以及理解他人的行为和感受至关重要。本研究在听觉模态下探究了处理群体情绪声音与个体情绪声音的认知和神经机制。我们记录了34名参与者对三种情绪效价（消极、中性、积极）的群体声音和个体声音的ERP反应。行为结果显示显著的交互作用：群体声音在中性和积极情绪下反应时更短，但在消极情绪下反应时更长，同时总体情绪反应更积极。在电生理层面，群体声音引发了更正的N1和更大的P2波幅，且潜伏期更短。具体而言，对于消极和积极声音，群体声音比个体声音诱发更大的P2波幅，而中性声音在群体与个体条件下无显著差异。此外，群体声音诱发的P2波幅与参与者的特质认知共情呈负相关。这些结果表明，群体声音通过声学凸显与社会凸显的交互作用，诱发了更强的早期神经反应。重要的是，研究并未直接证明共情特异性的神经机制，而是发现负相关表明特质共情可能在调节复杂集体情绪信号的早期感觉检测和注意加工中发挥作用。
关键词：群体情绪；个体情绪；面部/语音表情；ERP；共情

title: Human Brain Network for Reading the Mind from the Eyes: Beyond Activated and Deactivated Regions.
summary: BOLD signal changes in the Theory of Mind (ToM) network often reflect reduced deactivation during target conditions, yet these below-baseline effects remain largely unaddressed. Using fMRI data from an extended version of the Reading the Mind in the Eyes Test, we examined task-modulated functional connectivity (TMFC) of these areas. We revealed that, despite below-baseline BOLD responses during the reading the mind in the eyes (RME) task, TPJ-pSTS subregions in the left middle and superior temporal gyri, and angular gyrus (AG) demonstrated TMFC patterns closely resembling those of ToM network areas in the pSTS and inferior frontal gyrus (IFG) showing above-baseline activations. The RME task-associated network included regions supporting affective mentalizing (bilateral TPJ-pSTS, IFG, middle frontal gyri, precentral gyri, supplementary motor area) and face-processing areas. These areas also elicited reduced TMFC with ToM network subregions in the AG, supramarginal gyrus, precuneus, and medial prefrontal cortex, associated with cognitive mentalizing. These findings demonstrate that regions with greater BOLD responses during the RME task, despite these responses remaining below baseline, are functionally engaged. Together, the results indicate a dynamic interaction between ToM network subcomponents during the RME task, characterized by engagement of the affective subcomponent and its functional segregation from the cognitive subcomponent.

相关性：是  
标题：心灵从眼神中读取的大脑网络：超越激活与去激活区域  
摘要：心理理论（ToM）网络中的BOLD信号变化通常反映目标条件下减弱的去激活，但这些低于基线的效应在很大程度上未被充分探讨。利用扩展版“眼神读心测试”的fMRI数据，我们考察了这些区域的任务调制功能连接（TMFC）。我们发现，在“眼神读心”（RME）任务期间，尽管BOLD反应低于基线，但左侧颞中回、颞上回及角回（AG）中的颞顶联合区-后颞上沟（TPJ-pSTS）亚区表现出与显示超基线激活的pSTS和额下回（IFG）中ToM网络区域高度相似的TMFC模式。与RME任务相关的网络包括支持情感心理化的区域（双侧TPJ-pSTS、IFG、额中回、中央前回、辅助运动区）以及面部处理区域。这些区域还与AG、缘上回、楔前叶及内侧前额叶皮层中与认知心理化相关的ToM网络亚区引发了减弱的TMFC。这些发现表明，在RME任务期间BOLD反应更强（尽管仍低于基线）的区域在功能上被激活。综合来看，结果揭示了RME任务期间ToM网络子成分之间的动态相互作用，其特征为情感子成分的参与及其与认知子成分的功能分离。  
关键词：心理理论；眼神读心；功能连接；情感心理化；认知心理化

title: Fear, anxiety, and the extended amygdala-Absence of evidence for strict functional segregation.
summary: Since the time of Freud, the distinction between fear and anxiety has been a hallmark of influential models of emotion and emotional illness, including the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM) and Research Domain Criteria (RDoC). Fear and anxiety disorders are common, debilitating, and challenging to treat, underscoring the importance of developing accurate models of the underlying neurobiology. Although there is consensus that the extended amygdala (EA) plays a central role in orchestrating responses to threat, the respective contributions of its two major subdivisions-the central nucleus of the amygdala (Ce) and bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BST)-remain contentious. To help adjudicate this debate, we performed a harmonized mega-analysis of fMRI data acquired from 295 adults as they completed a well-established threat-anticipation paradigm. Contrary to popular double-dissociation models, results demonstrated that the Ce responds to temporally uncertain threat and the BST responds to certain threat. In direct comparisons, the two regions showed statistically indistinguishable responses, with strong Bayesian evidence of regional equivalence. In contrast, frontocortical regions responded preferentially to uncertain-threat anticipation. Together, these observations underscore the need to reformulate conceptual models that posit a strict segregation of temporally certain and uncertain threat processing in the EA.

相关性：是
标题：恐惧、焦虑与扩展杏仁核——严格功能分离假说的证据缺失
摘要：自弗洛伊德时代以来，恐惧与焦虑的区分一直是情绪与情绪疾病重要模型的标志性特征，包括《精神疾病诊断与统计手册》（DSM）和研究领域标准（RDoC）。恐惧和焦虑障碍常见、致残且治疗困难，这凸显了建立准确神经生物学基础模型的重要性。尽管学界共识认为扩展杏仁核（EA）在组织对威胁的反应中发挥核心作用，但其两大主要分区——杏仁核中央核（Ce）和终纹床核（BST）——各自的功能贡献仍存在争议。为协助解决这一争论，我们对295名成人完成一项完善的威胁预期范式时采集的fMRI数据进行了协调化元分析。与流行的双重分离模型相反，结果表明Ce对时间不确定的威胁产生反应，而BST对确定的威胁产生反应。在直接比较中，两个区域表现出统计上无差异的反应，并有强贝叶斯证据支持区域等效性。相比之下，额叶皮层区域优先对不确定的威胁预期做出反应。这些观察共同强调，需要重新构建那些认为扩展杏仁核中时间确定与不确定威胁处理存在严格分离的概念模型。
关键词：恐惧，焦虑，扩展杏仁核，功能分离，威胁预期

title: Age-related neural dynamics of empathy in preschoolers: An EEG study with naturalistic viewing.
summary: Empathy development in early childhood involves complex neurocognitive processes, but the neural mechanisms underlying this development have yet to be fully explored. This study combined EEG microstate and spectral analyses to investigate empathy-related neural processes in 71 typically developing preschoolers (aged 3-6 years) during naturalistic viewing of socioemotional animations. Spectral analysis revealed increased occipital theta, centrotemporal alpha and temporal beta activities during empathy-eliciting clips compared to baseline. Theta activity in response to Theory of Mind (ToM) clips negatively correlated with children's negative emotion understanding, while alpha activity during Emotional Contagion (EC) clips positively correlated with positive emotion resonance. Age-related decreases in occipital theta power and increases in centrotemporal alpha power were observed, paralleling behavioral improvements in prosocial helping behavior. Microstate analysis identified hierarchical age-related shifts: reduced coverage of microstate MS5 and increased transitions from MS5 to MS2 during ToM processing, implying that as children mature, perspective-taking efficiency increases, redirecting neural resources to response preparation. These findings suggest an age-related neural cascade framework where perceptual efficiency gains may free cognitive resources for mentalizing and emotion regulation, enabling more advanced prosocial actions. The present work suggests that EEG spectral and microstate metrics serve as sensitive neurophysiological indices for assessing early childhood age-related changes in empathy within naturalistic contexts.

标题：学龄前儿童共情能力的年龄相关神经动态：一项基于自然观察情境的EEG研究
摘要：幼儿期共情发展涉及复杂的神经认知过程，但支撑这一发展的神经机制尚未完全阐明。本研究结合EEG微状态和频谱分析，探究71名典型发育学龄前儿童（3-6岁）在自然观察社会情感动画过程中的共情相关神经过程。频谱分析显示，与基线相比，共情诱发片段期间枕区θ波、中央颞区α波和颞区β波活动增强。心理理论片段诱发的θ波活动与儿童对负性情绪的理解呈负相关，而情绪 contagion 片段期间的α波活动与正性情绪共鸣呈正相关。研究观察到与年龄相关的枕区θ波功率下降和中央颞区α波功率上升，这与亲社会助人行为的改善相平行。微状态分析揭示了层次化的年龄相关转变：在心理理论加工过程中，微状态MS5覆盖率降低，MS5向MS2的转换增加，表明随着儿童成熟，观点采择效率提高，神经资源转向反应准备。这些发现提示存在年龄相关的神经级联框架，其中知觉效率的提升可能释放认知资源用于心理化和情绪调节，从而支持更高级的亲社会行为。本研究提出，在自然观察情境下，EEG频谱和微状态指标可作为评估幼儿期共情能力年龄相关变化的敏感神经生理指标。

title: The why behind the how: The association between motive and strategy use in interpersonal emotion regulation.
summary: Interpersonal emotion regulation is a central means through which people seek and provide emotional support. Understanding people's motives for engaging in interpersonal emotion regulation-and how these motives relate to the strategies they report receiving from and providing to others-can reveal the potential alignment or mismatch in why certain regulation strategies are deployed. In two daily life studies (Ntotal = 402), we captured interpersonal emotion regulation from the perspective of the person soliciting emotion regulation from others (i.e., intrinsic regulation) and providing emotion regulation to others (i.e., extrinsic regulation). In doing so, we explored whether people's regulation motives (i.e., to feel better, get work done, build relationships, and seek or provide perspective) predicted their perception of the regulation strategy (i.e., reappraisal, valuing, distraction, and suppression) they received from and provided to others in everyday social interactions. We found motives people held for turning to others to regulate their own emotions were largely not associated with strategies they reported receiving. However, motives people held for regulating others' emotions were associated with strategies they themselves provided. For instance, people reported making others feel valued and cared for more when holding a motive of wanting others to feel better, recommended suppressing emotions less when holding a motive to build social bonds, and encouraged reappraisal more when holding a motive to provide advice and perspective. Overall, our research highlights a potential gap between the emotional support people want from others and the emotional support they feel they receive, pointing to an avenue of intervention to improve relational and individual well-being. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).

标题：行为背后的动机：人际情绪调节中动机与策略使用的关联
摘要：人际情绪调节是人们寻求和提供情感支持的核心途径。理解人们参与人际情绪调节的动机——以及这些动机如何与他们报告从他人处接受到及向他人提供的策略相关联——可以揭示某些调节策略被使用背后潜在的一致性或不匹配。通过两项日常生活研究（总样本量N=402），我们从寻求他人情绪调节（即内在调节）和向他人提供情绪调节（即外在调节）的双重视角捕捉了人际情绪调节。我们探讨了人们的调节动机（即感觉更好、完成工作、建立关系、寻求或提供视角）是否预测了他们在日常社交互动中感知到的从他人处接受到和向他人提供的调节策略（即重新评估、重视、分散注意和压抑）。结果发现，人们向他人寻求情绪调节的动机与他们报告接受到的策略大多没有关联。然而，人们调节他人情绪的动机与他们自己提供的策略相关联。例如，当人们持有让他人感觉更好的动机时，更倾向于让他人感到被重视和被关心；当持有建立社会纽带的动机时，更少建议压抑情绪；当持有提供建议和视角的动机时，更鼓励重新评估。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了人们希望从他人处获得的情感支持与他们实际感受到的情感支持之间的潜在差距，为改善关系和个人幸福感提供了干预路径。（PsycInfo数据库记录（c）2026 APA，版权所有）
关键词：人际情绪调节；情绪调节动机；情绪调节策略；社会互动；情感支持

title: A critical test of emotion regulation strategy effectiveness in daily life: Individual differences and situational contexts.
summary: Emotion regulation is considered central to hedonic well-being, with substantial evidence linking emotion regulation strategies to indicators of physical and mental health. Research has typically emphasized the general short-term effectiveness of specific strategies, assuming that some reliably regulate affect more successfully than others. However, this approach has critical limitations. To evaluate its validity, we conducted a coordinated data analysis of 12 ambulatory assessment data sets (N = 1,511 participants; N = 161,513 measurement occasions) examining strategy effectiveness in daily life. Acceptance, reappraisal, and social sharing were, on average, associated with more favorable subsequent affect, whereas rumination, suppression, and, to a lesser extent, distraction were not. Yet there was substantial between-person variability in the effectiveness of every strategy, indicating that strategies considered effective on average were ineffective or even counterproductive for a meaningful subset of individuals. Most strikingly, approximately 75%-80% of the variance in effectiveness was explained by the intensity of the affective state individuals were attempting to regulate, suggesting that observed effectiveness largely reflects situational difficulty rather than intrinsic properties of strategies. A complementary analysis of a novel measure of negative affect pile-up further revealed a shift from greater reliance on putatively adaptive strategies during brief spikes in negative affect to greater reliance on putatively maladaptive strategies as elevated negative affect persisted. Together, these findings challenge the prevailing focus on short-term, strategy-level effectiveness in everyday life and highlight the need for emotion regulation assessments that better capture person-strategy-situation fit and the temporal dynamics of emotional episodes. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).

标题：日常生活中情绪调节策略有效性的关键检验：个体差异与情境背景
摘要：情绪调节被视为享乐幸福感的核心，大量证据将情绪调节策略与身心健康指标联系起来。研究通常强调特定策略在短期内的普遍有效性，假设某些策略比其它策略更能可靠地成功调节情绪。然而，这种方法存在关键局限性。为了评估其有效性，我们对12个动态评估数据集（总参与人数N=1,511；总测量次数N=161,513）进行了协调数据分析，考察了日常生活中情绪调节策略的有效性。平均而言，接纳、重新评估和社会分享与更有利的后续情绪相关，而反刍、抑制以及较小程度上的分散注意力则不然。然而，每种策略的有效性存在显著的个体间差异，表明平均而言被认为有效的策略对一部分有意义的个体是无效甚至适得其反的。最显著的是，约75%-80%的有效性变异可由个体试图调节的情绪状态的强度解释，这表明观察到的有效性在很大程度上反映了情境难度，而非策略的内在属性。对一种新型负性情绪累积量表的补充分析进一步揭示，在负性情绪的短暂高峰期间，个体更依赖假定适应性策略，而当负性情绪持续升高时，则转向更依赖假定适应不良策略。总之，这些发现挑战了当前对日常生活中短期的、策略层面有效性的关注，并强调了需要能更好捕捉人-策略-情境匹配以及情绪事件时间动态的情绪调节评估方法。（PsycInfo数据库记录 (c) 2026 APA，版权所有。）
关键词：情绪调节；有效性；个体差异；情境背景；时间动态

title: Scaffolding the Social Mind: Emotion Recognition Supports Mentalizing but Reinforces Bias.
summary: Mentalizing-inferring others' mental states-is a core social function supported by both perceptual and contextual processes. Emotion recognition similarly unfolds in two stages: early perceptual decoding of facial features followed by context-sensitive interpretation. Here, we tested whether emotion recognition scaffolds mentalizing across these stages and whether they attenuate or amplify social bias. Participants (N = 34) completed a face categorization task during EEG recording, in which mentalizing was operationalized as differential neural responses to mindful (human) versus mindless (doll-like) faces, while perceptual (neutral vs. smiling) and contextual (ingroup vs. outgroup) cues were systematically manipulated. Early neural responses differentiated human from doll-like faces, indicating rapid mind detection despite perceptual similarity. Smiling expressions enhanced early neural sensitivity across both human and doll-like faces, suggesting that emotional information is extracted at early perceptual stages independently of stimulus humanity. Later EEG components revealed an asymmetry: emotional expressions selectively boosted mental state attribution for ingroup faces, reflecting the integration of contextual social information at later stages. Implicit association tests confirmed this pattern, with mind-related concepts more strongly associated with smiling ingroup faces.

标题：社会心智的脚手架：情绪识别支持心理化但强化偏见  
摘要：心理化——推断他人的心理状态——是一种依赖于知觉和语境过程的核社会功能。情绪识别同样分为两个阶段：面部特征的早期知觉解码，以及随后的语境敏感解释。在本研究中，我们检验了情绪识别是否在这两个阶段中为心理化提供支持，以及它们是否减弱或强化了社会偏见。参与者（N=34）在脑电图记录期间完成了一项面部分类任务，其中心理化被操作化为对有心智（人类）与无心智（玩偶状）面孔的差异性神经反应，同时系统操纵了知觉线索（中性 vs. 微笑）和语境线索（内群体 vs. 外群体）。早期神经反应区分别了人类与玩偶状面孔，表明尽管知觉相似性，存在快速的意识检测。微笑表情增强了人类和玩偶状面孔的早期神经敏感性，提示情绪信息在早期知觉阶段被提取，且独立于刺激的心智属性。随后脑电图成分揭示了一种不对称性：情绪表达选择性地增强了内群体面孔的心理状态归因，反映了在后期阶段对语境社会信息的整合。内隐联想测试证实了这一模式，即与心智相关的概念更强烈地与微笑的内群体面孔相关联。

title: Fluency as a Cue to Authenticity.
summary: The quest for authenticity is a potent existential striving. Commonly defined as knowing and living in accordance with one's perceived "true self," we propose that authenticity may also be inferred from ambient feelings of fluency, or the subjective feeling of ease that corresponds to one's immediate experience, mental processing, or physical action. We report four studies (N = 1,465) supporting this idea. Study 1 shows that fluency during a recent activity predicts subjective authenticity beyond other relevant variables. Study 2 demonstrates that participants' recalled fluent experiences also felt authentic. In Study 3, generating self-defining attributes under cognitive load reduced fluency and, subsequently, subjective authenticity. Finally, preregistered Study 4 manipulated fluency during a non-self-relevant task. Participants in the fluent condition reported greater subjective authenticity than those in the disfluent condition. We discuss how a phenomenological approach to subjective authenticity can integrate and complement recent theorizing about the nature of authenticity.

标题：流畅性作为真实性的线索
摘要：对真实性的追求是一种强大的存在主义努力。通常被定义为已知并按照感知到的“真实自我”生活，我们提出真实性也可能从周围环境的流畅感中推断出来，或者是从与即时体验、心理过程或身体动作相对应的主观轻松感中推断出来。我们报告了四项研究（N = 1,465）支持这一观点。研究1显示，近期活动中的流畅性能够预测在超出其他相关变量之外的主观真实性。研究2表明，参与者回忆中的流畅体验也同样感觉真实。在研究3中，在认知负荷下生成自我定义属性降低了流畅性，进而降低了主观真实性。最后，预先注册的研究4操纵了非自我相关任务中的流畅性。流畅条件下的参与者报告的主观真实性高于不流畅条件下的参与者。我们讨论了如何通过现象学方法研究主观真实性，以整合和补充关于真实性本质的最新理论。

title: Attentional bias to situational and implicational information and individual differences in anxiety reactivity and perseveration.
summary: There are notable individual differences in how people manage the lead up to, and aftermath of, stressful events. Trait anxiety has consistently been identified as a key factor contributing to these differences. There is growing consensus that trait anxiety is multidimensional, comprising two distinct dimensions, anxiety reactivity and anxiety perseveration. Yet the cognitive mechanisms driving individual differences in these dimensions remain unclear. The present study investigated the potential role of attentional bias towards information differing in content (situational vs. implicational) and valence (negative vs. positive) in driving these individual differences. Undergraduate university students (N = 93) completed a dual-probe assessment task which presented video clips varying in content and valence. State anxiety was assessed at crucial junctures throughout the experimental session to index anxiety reactivity and perseveration. Results revealed attentional bias for negative implicational information played a significant role in predicting anxiety perseveration. Conversely, attention bias for negative situational information was not a significant predictor of anxiety reactivity. Findings are discussed with reference to limitations and future extensions that could build on these findings to address causality and develop interventions capable of modifying cognitive biases.

标题：情境性与意涵性信息的注意偏向及焦虑反应性与持续性的个体差异
摘要：人们在应对压力事件的前期准备和后期反应方面存在显著的个体差异。特质焦虑一直被确认为导致这些差异的关键因素。越来越多共识认为，特质焦虑是多维度的，包含两个独立的维度：焦虑反应性和焦虑持续性。然而，驱动这些维度个体差异的认知机制尚不清楚。本研究探讨了注意偏向对不同内容（情境性vs.意涵性）和效价（消极vs.积极）信息的作用，以揭示其如何驱动这些个体差异。93名大学生完成了一项双探测评估任务，该任务呈现了不同内容和效价的视频片段。在实验过程中的关键节点评估状态焦虑，以衡量焦虑反应性和持续性。结果显示，对消极意涵信息的注意偏向在预测焦虑持续性方面具有显著作用。相反，对消极情境信息的注意偏向并不能显著预测焦虑反应性。本文基于研究的局限性讨论了这些发现，并提出了未来可在此基础上进一步探讨因果关系及开发修改认知偏好的干预措施的扩展方向。

title: The unique effect of the number of children on mothers' acceptance of children's negative emotions.
summary: Although parenting research typically focuses on one target child, parents' emotion-related parenting behaviours are predicted by the broader family context. The number of children in the home impacts parents' emotional resources and may be particularly relevant to mothers' beliefs about acceptable emotional displays from their young children. Participants included 226 Portuguese mothers of a 2- to 6-year-old target child (M = 3.89 years) with between 1 and 4 children. Mothers reported on their family makeup, tolerance of their child's dominant and submissive negative emotion displays, parenting stress and mindful parenting. Covarying maternal age, family income and target child age, regressions revealed that mothers with more children were less likely to endorse beliefs that it was acceptable for their young child to display dominant negative emotions. Mothers were also more tolerant of displays of dominant negative emotions for younger children than older children within this early childhood period. These effects remained even after accounting for mothers' parenting stress and mindfulness. Results are interpreted using social information processing, emotion socialisation and transactional stress and coping perspectives.

标题：子女数量对母亲接纳儿童负性情绪的独特影响
摘要：尽管养育研究通常聚焦于单个目标儿童，但父母与情绪相关的养育行为受到更广泛的家庭背景的预测。家庭中子女的数量会影响父母的情绪资源，尤其可能与母亲对幼儿可接受情绪表达的信念相关。研究参与者包括226名葡萄牙母亲，她们有一个年龄在2至6岁之间的目标儿童（平均年龄=3.89岁），且家中子女数量介于1至4个之间。母亲们报告了家庭构成、对儿童主导性和顺从性负性情绪表达的容忍度、养育压力以及正念养育情况。在协变量包括母亲年龄、家庭收入和目标儿童年龄的情况下，回归分析显示，子女数量较多的母亲更不容易认可接受幼儿表达主导性负性情绪的信念。此外，在幼儿期这个阶段，母亲对更年幼儿童表达主导性负性情绪的容忍度高于年长儿童。即使在控制母亲的养育压力和正念水平后，这些效应依然存在。研究者从社会信息加工、情绪社会化以及交易性压力与应对视角对结果进行了解释。

title: Others' facial and bodily expressions of emotion modulate willingness to engage in joint action - but actions and objects matter too.
summary: Emotions are fundamental to social cognition, yet their role in joint action remains underexplored. This study examined how emotional expressions (angry, sad, happy, and neutral) influence behavioural readiness (willingness to engage) in an object-handover task. Across two experiments, participants rated their willingness to "give" or "take" an object (spoon or knife) while viewing dynamic point-light displays (PLDs) of facial (Experiment 1) or bodily (Experiment 2) expressions. Results showed that, although both modalities influenced willingness, guided social decision-making relied on distinct functional heuristics. For facial expressions, a strong emotion-action congruency effect emerged: positive expressions facilitated prosocial "giving", whereas anger, a direct threat cue, inhibited willingness to engage, particularly when paired with a dangerous object. In contrast, bodily expressions were interpreted through a lens of physical vulnerability and predictability. For example, sad and neutral bodies elicited high willingness, suggesting they were perceived as low-threat or stable. Notably, across both experiments, self-directed "take" actions overrode emotional cues, indicating that personal goals may diminish sensitivity to others' expressions. These findings suggest that facial and bodily cues are not functionally equivalent. Rather, they provide complementary social information (intent vs. readiness) that uniquely shapes coordination in joint action contexts.

标题：他人的面部和身体情绪表达调节参与联合行动的意愿——但行动和物体本身也很重要  
摘要：情绪是社会认知的基础，但它们如何在联合行动中发挥作用仍未被充分探索。本研究考察了情绪表达（愤怒、悲伤、快乐和中性）如何影响物体交接任务中的行为准备状态（参与意愿）。在两个实验中，参与者观看面部（实验1）或身体（实验2）动态点光显示的情绪表达，并评估他们“给予”或“拿取”物体（勺子或刀子）的意愿。结果显示，尽管两种方式都影响了意愿，但引导社会决策依赖于不同的功能启发式。对于面部表情，出现了显著的情绪-行动一致性效应：积极情绪促进了亲社会的“给予”，而愤怒作为一种直接威胁线索抑制了参与意愿，尤其是在与危险物体配对时。相比之下，身体表情则通过身体脆弱性和可预测性来解释。例如，悲伤和中性身体引发了较高的意愿，表明它们被视为低威胁或稳定。值得注意的是，在两个实验中，以自我为导向的“拿取”行动压倒了情绪线索，表明个人目标可能削弱对他人表达的敏感性。这些发现表明，面部和身体线索在功能上不等同。相反，它们提供了互补的社会信息（意图与准备状态），独特地塑造了联合行动情境中的协调。

title: Contemptuous expressions during encoding attenuate facial identity recognition in visual working memory in social anxiety: behavioural and electrophysiological evidence.
summary: The cognitive-behavioural model emphasises that processing biases are central to the development and maintenance of social anxiety. This study examined how contemptuous facial expressions during encoding influence subsequent recognition of neutral face identity in visual working memory. 32 socially anxious individuals and 32 healthy controls completed a delayed face discrimination task while ERPs were recorded. Behaviourally, socially anxious participants showed lower discrimination sensitivity (d', discrimination power of face identity recognition) and reduced hit rates for faces encoded with contemptuous versus happy expressions, whereas healthy controls showed comparable d' and hit rates across expression conditions. Neurally, socially anxious individuals exhibited larger P1 amplitudes during encoding, enhanced N170 amplitudes for contemptuous faces, and reduced N170 and N250 amplitudes to neutral probes previously encoded with contemptuous expressions. In contrast, healthy controls showed no significant ERP differences between expression conditions. Together, these results indicate that socially threatening cues elicit heightened early perceptual processing but impair the formation and retrieval of facial identity representations, providing converging behavioural and electrophysiological evidence of negative processing bias in social anxiety.

标题：社交焦虑中编码时的轻蔑表情减弱视觉工作记忆中的面部身份识别：行为与电生理证据
摘要：认知行为模型强调，加工偏差是社交焦虑发生和维持的核心。本研究考察了编码过程中轻蔑面部表情如何影响后续视觉工作记忆中对中性面孔身份的认识。32名社交焦虑个体和32名健康对照者完成了一项延迟面孔辨别任务，同时记录事件相关电位。行为上，与快乐表情相比，社交焦虑参与者对编码为轻蔑表情的面孔表现出更低的辨别敏感性（d'，面孔身份识别的辨别力）和更低的命中率，而健康对照组在不同表情条件下的d'和命中率相当。神经层面，社交焦虑个体在编码期间表现出更大的P1波幅，对轻蔑面孔的N170波幅增强，以及对先前编码为轻蔑表情的中性探测刺激的N170和N250波幅减弱。相比之下，健康对照组在不同表情条件之间未表现出显著的ERP差异。总之，这些结果表明，社交威胁性线索会引发增强的早期知觉加工，但损害面部身份表征的形成和提取，为社交焦虑中的负性加工偏差提供了行为与电生理的汇聚证据。
关键词：社交焦虑；轻蔑表情；面部身份识别；事件相关电位；加工偏差
